headline: Spider-Man and The Odyssey are splitting up IMAX screens after a record-breaking weekend
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day joins The Odyssey in IMAX theaters after a record-breaking box office weekend. Spider-Man will be available in select digital IMAX locations starting Thursday, August 6th. The Odyssey's exclusive three-weekend run is now sharing screen time.

headline: Samsung’s 2TB 9100 Pro SSD is actually somewhat reasonably priced
summary: Finding fast, high-capacity NVMe SSDs at a good price has been difficult. Samsung's 2TB 9100 Pro SSD is now cheaper than it has been since February 2026. The heatsink-less version is currently available on Amazon at a reasonable cost.

headline: Lenovo Googlebook leaks reveal a laptop and 2-in-1 tablet
summary: Leaked press images reveal designs for Lenovo's upcoming Googlebook models. The leaks include both a laptop and a versatile 2-in-1 tablet. All devices clearly feature Googlebook branding, hinting at their imminent release.

headline: Big Walk is like co-op Breath of the Wild
summary: Big Walk is the next game from House House, creators of Untitled Goose Game. It's described as a co-operative exploration experience. The game is being compared to a co-op version of Breath of the Wild.

headline: Warhammer 40,000 Animated Series Produced by Henry Cavill to Tell a 'Long-Form Story' Featuring The Deathwatch
summary: An Amazon-developed Warhammer 40,000 animated series is in production. Henry Cavill is set to executive produce the show. The series will tell a long-form story focused on The Deathwatch.

headline: Upcoming LEGO Sets: Release Dates for 2026 and Beyond
summary: This list provides frequently updated information on major upcoming LEGO sets. It includes details on release dates and pricing. Sets scheduled for 2026 and beyond are highlighted.

headline: Rust Fan Sues Police After Swatting Incident Leaves Him Paralyzed
summary: A Rust player was left paralyzed following a swatting incident involving police. He is now suing the police department for $176 million. The lawsuit alleges serious injuries sustained during the encounter.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Almost Featured a Bizarre, Sticky Marvel Supervillain
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton revealed a cut character. A unique, sticky Marvel supervillain was originally considered for the film. The character ultimately did not make it into the final movie.

headline: English FA set to withdraw support for Fifa president Infantino
summary: The English Football Association plans to withdraw its support for Fifa president Gianni Infantino. This decision aligns with Wales's earlier announcement to also withdraw backing. The move impacts Infantino's bid for re-election as Fifa president.

headline: Mother has pioneering womb surgery to fix baby's intestines - before he's even born
summary: Theo became the first British baby to undergo pioneering in-womb surgery. The procedure aimed to correct complex gastroschisis before his birth. This groundbreaking operation was part of an innovative clinical trial.

headline: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
summary: Iran confirms ongoing talks with Oman but denies any negotiations with the US. This statement follows former President Trump's claim of resuming talks with Tehran. Iran has previously closed the strait after US and Israeli attacks in February.

headline: BBC reports from inside city gripped by deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
summary: The BBC gained exclusive access to Rawalakot, a city in Pakistan-administered Kashmir. Rawalakot is currently experiencing violent clashes and deadly protests. Security forces have been confronting demonstrators in the area.
